Subject: MAP: timeline for final go/no-go and signatures

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for walking through the MAP yesterday. We reviewed the updated MAP_v3.pdf overnight and have two coordination asks before we can lock a start date:

1) Confirmation of the exact signature windows for Rector Legal and our procurement team (they have limited availability the week of Jun 14).
2) A final SOW that reflects the three minor scope clarifications we discussed (paging + one-off evaluation harness).

If we can get a firm signature cadence and a confirmed Day 1 (preferred Jun 21), procurement can queue PO and release internal approvals. Can Redwood supply a condensed paperflow (who signs first, expected turnaround per signer) and confirm whether you can accommodate an eSign with a two-signer parallel flow?

Attaching: MAP_v3.pdf (our annotated copy).

—Lena

Subject: Re: MAP: timeline for final go/no-go and signatures

Thanks Lena — good questions. Short answers up front: yes, we can support parallel eSign for two signers and we can propose explicit signer order to satisfy Rector Legal.

Proposed paperflow (condensed):
- Redwood sends eSign packet to Acme (Procurement + Legal) and Redwood Legal simultaneously.
- Acme Procurement (PO) signs first; Acme Legal countersigns within 48 hours.
- Redwood Legal completes counterpart signature within 24 hours of Acme Legal.

We can fit the eSign packet into the week of Jun 14 if Acme commits to 48-hour turnaround on review. If the start date target is Jun 21, the critical path is: SOW finalization by Jun 8, DocuSign out by Jun 10, signatures complete by Jun 16, PO and procurement processing Jun 17–18, onboarding kickoff Jun 21.

I've attached a clean SOW draft with the three clarifications incorporated (SOW_v2_redlines.docx). Kimberly — can you confirm Redwood Legal is good with the proposed signer order and 24–48 hour windows? Priyom — can you confirm onboarding availability for a Jun 21 start (we need the dedicated engineer onboarding slot and a 2‑hour kickoff meeting that week)?

Thanks,
Neha

Subject: Final: signoff cadence confirmed / DocuSign out Jun 10 / Jun 21 Day‑1 target

Lena / Mark —

Thanks for the fast turn. Based on today's alignment call and the attachments below, here is the agreed final runbook to close and kick:

1) SOW: neha_kapoor has attached the clean SOW (SOW_v2_clean.docx). This is the version we will send for eSign. (Attachment: esign_request.pdf stubs the DocuSign packet.)
2) DocuSign schedule: Redwood will issue DocuSign on Jun 10 at 09:00 PT. Acme Procurement to sign within 48 hours (target Jun 12). Acme Legal to countersign by Jun 14. Redwood Legal will countersign same day (Jun 14) on receipt.
3) PO & billing: Once fully executed, Acme to issue PO and finance to begin provisioning. Please route PO to billing@redwood.com and cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com.
4) Day 1 start: Pending signatures and PO, Redwood schedules onboarding kickoff for Jun 21 at 10:00 PT. Priyom will lead the onboarding call and allocate a named engineer for the first two weeks.

Contingency: If Acme needs more time and signatures slip beyond Jun 16, we will push Day 1 to Jun 28 and trigger a readout / contingency checklist (license, IP, access windows).

Please reply with a one-line confirm if this runbook matches Acme's expectations. Once I have a confirm, I'll issue DocuSign and share the HubSpot deal update link.

Attachments: SOW_v2_clean.docx, esign_request.pdf (DocuSign packet).

Best,
